title: Scan.toml [rule] filters (include) with custom analyzers
description: Upstream fixture: Scan.toml declares exampleOrg/ballerina/ballerinax analyzers plus a [rule] table with include = ["ballerina:1"]. From 0.13.0 --include-rules or --exclude-rules replaces the whole [rule] table, with a warning that names what it drops; earlier versions add the CLI rules to the Scan.toml ones.

steps.name: Scan.toml + CLI include
steps.note: From 0.13.0 only ballerina:13 runs, with a warning: --include-rules=ballerina:13 overrides [rule] include = ["ballerina:1"] in Scan.toml. Before, ballerina:1 and ballerina:13 both run.

steps.name: Scan.toml + CLI exclude
steps.note: From 0.13.0 every rule but ballerina:13 runs, with the override warning. Before, this is the 'cannot include and exclude rules' error.
